rows.text: Board approves a revised Rs 3.64 cr consideration (up from Rs 2.60 lakh) for its already-disclosed acquisition of a 26% stake in Asawata Energy Private Limited for a 15 MW captive solar plant (filed four times; carried once -- the baseline's Rs 180 cr on this line is the same filing's separate, not-yet-committed capex plan, see Capex).
